title: Apply Review Feedback to Energy Videos and Render Finals
description: Apply the reviewer feedback (units notation, references, symbols per DIN 4108-6, roadmap placement, ventilation/cooling/heating scene corrections, UI introduction using real frames instead of ad hoc placeholders) to the architecture energy course videos and render them end to end as final videos.
